scope: Affine native-element Legendre decomposition with physical GL8 integration, exact for squared cubic fields. Outside local Q1 is orthogonal to every local Q1 pressure polynomial; continuous global pressure has additional conformity restrictions. This is not a global pressure-space feasibility or inf-sup proof, not a curved-metric claim, not a residual percentage, and not a runtime correction. Production terms retain their signed projection and are not added as norms.
